summary: VCI Global Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement amending a prior convertible note prospectus supplement to reduce the number of ordinary shares issuable to Alumni Capital LP from 55,556 to 19,990 upon conversion of convertible notes and exercise of warrants under an August 13, 2025 securities purchase agreement. The filing reflects 1-for-60 and 1-for-15 reverse stock splits effected in 2026. All shares covered have been sold and issued. This is a routine regulatory amendment to a securities issuance, not a special situation event.
